purpose: Per-operator timing of the PAMAP2 TFLite models (cause analysis, experiment 3).
tool: TFLite benchmark_model, official nightly build linux_aarch64_benchmark_model
environment: Podman Linux VM (libkrun, 4 vCPU, 2 GiB) on the same Apple M1 Pro Mac; container debian:bookworm-slim 12.15; kernel 7.1.10-200.fc44.aarch64
models: Same files as results/2026-11-10-macos-pamap2-models (SHA-256 checked against its metrics.json before the run).
input: benchmark_model default random input; timing only, no accuracy.

files.node-types.csv: per node type average time from the regular benchmark runs

limits: Linux VM, not macOS or Windows; profiler reports ms with 3 decimals; single session of 1,000 runs; profiling adds overhead so per-op sums differ from avg_us.
